-----------------------------Update Log----------------------------

Version 1.0: Launch (10-30-17)

Version 1.2: Minor fixes—added spin out sound; karts do not spin out when throwing a shell or when they hit an item with a star. Track pieces will only stay in place as clones. (11-1-17)

Version 1.4: Music has been added! (11-15-17)

Version 1.8: Added pipes and a tutorial, starring Lakitu! Also fixed some bugs. (12-9-17)

Version 1.9: Fixed an annoying bug that caused the spin out sound to play infinitely. Also combined a few scripts to reduce lag. (12-23-17)

Version 2.0: Added the trash! Now you can delete those pesky accidentally placed pieces! Also made slight changes to tutorial. (date unknown)

Version 2.2: Added the Winter theme (suggested by @BornToGolf), complete with a background and road! Also fixed a bug with respawning after falling into water. (7-7-18)

Version 2.6: Fixed a bug that reset Mario's item reel when Luigi used an item. You also no longer can get an item box after already having an item, and item boxes will now break when you get them. The GUI has been rearranged as well to reflect what each piece does and the title screen and tutorial have been updated to reflect this. (7-19-18)

Version 2.8: Updated water background and fixed a bug that caused the player to react as though they had fallen into lava when being hit by a red shell and another one that caused Luigi to act as though being hit by an item when touching Mario. (7-22-18)

Version 3.0: Added acceleration and fixed a few bugs. Also updated the water background again. (7-23-18)

Version 3.2: Boost pads are not activated when Lakitu is carrying you back to the track. Mario and Luigi now show in Edit Mode as ghosts and their size can be changed. The sprites have been slightly changed for Mario, Luigi, the Go! button, and the start line. Thanks to @VivaTorterra12 for suggesting! (9-20-18)

Version 3.3: Fixed a problem with items. Thanks again to @VivaTorterra12! Also fixed a problem with the new ghost effect feature, updated off-road speed, and fixed a coding bug with Luigi that rendered him immobile if he stopped on grass. (9-21-18)

Version 3.5: Fixed a bug where pipes could not be dragged to the trash, and made walls a bit bouncier so that hitting them is less punishing. Thanks to @StefanMB for pointing out those issues! I also discovered and removed an invisible hitbox present on curved walls that could cause problems. (2-1-21)

Version 3.6: Fixed a bug where bananas stayed on the track after being hit by the player who deployed them. (2-27-21)

Version 3.7: Fixed a bug where karts would remain semi-drivable in Edit mode, and ending the tutorial early no longer causes any major issues with Lakitu. Additionally, I've noticed that the startup sound and all the music have disappeared for some reason. This may be something to fix in the future. (5-11-23)

MESSAGE: Howdy, player! I'm Lakitu, and I'm here to teach you how to play Super Mario Kart Maker!
First, you're gonna start by clicking the straight track piece in the item bar.
Good. Now move that mouse of yours down to where your track will start, and click again to place it.
Good. Now, you're gonna press space to delete the new track piece in your hand so we can continue.
Fantastic. Now you'll be clickin' that there starting line.
Then, you'll move the mouse to your track and hold the mouse down for a second to place the starting line there.
Okay. Now I'll be explainin' what each item up here will do.
The first one, as y'all know, is the straight track. You can change its look with the number keys.
The next one is the curved track. It acts just like straight track, 'cept it's curved.
This one's the wall piece. You can change it with the ASDFGH keys, making it curved or with a different style.
Then, of course, is the pipe. If you run into it, you'll stop and have to go around it.
This here is the boost. If you run over it, you'll go faster for a short time.
Next up is the jumps. When you run over those, you'll jump straight up and over walls, pipes, and pits.
The last one is an item box. Hitting it will give you a random item that you can use with the down arrow.
On a side note, almost all of these can be rotated with the right and left arrows or made bigger with the up and down ones.
It's also important to remember that you can change the background with QWERTY. Some backgrounds will act differently than others.
All items can be destroyed if you don't want 'em by pressin' the space bar.
If you've already placed a piece but ya don't wanna keep it, you can drag it into the trash here in the top left!
You can also select music to use by clicking the music icon and selecting a song.
If you're playing with a friend, click the One Player button and it'll change to Two Players.
Don't forget that when you finish, you can click the Go! flag to start. Have fun!
